paper.title_en: Two-scale system: compactified ambient metrics and Scri/Spi/Ti
paper.abstract_en: We show that certain geometric constructions, including the Fefferman-Graham ambient metric, Brinkmann spaces, and ultrastatic vacuum spacetimes, admit natural conformal compactifications and can be unified within a single framework arising naturally from conformal geometry. The framework is based on a two-scale system comprising two weight-one conformal scalars satisfying almost-Einstein equations and certain regularity conditions. As a particular instance of this unifying framework, we obtain a new ambient construction for Spi and Ti, the extended spatial and temporal infinities of Ricci-flat spacetimes. A remarkable feature of this construction is that Spi/Ti and the null infinity of the corresponding spacetimes are naturally realised as a boundary face and the corner of the two-scale ambient space, respectively. We also demonstrate how the two-scale system can serve as a background ambient geometry for studying the asymptotic behaviour of (gauge) fields at spatial, temporal, and null infinity.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究共形几何中双尺度系统与Fefferman-Graham环境度量的统一框架，并给出Ricci平坦时空空间/时间无穷远Spi/Ti的新环境构造，涉及零无穷远边界结构，属于广义相对论基础中的共形紧致化与渐近结构问题。理论深度和框架统一性较强，摘要清晰但方法细节有限；新论文零引用按中性处理，不降低评分。
decision.title_zh: 双尺度系统：紧致化环境度量与 Scri/Spi/Ti
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明，某些几何构造——包括 Fefferman-Graham 环境度量、Brinkmann 空间以及超静态真空时空——允许自然的共形紧致化，并且可以统一在一个由共形几何自然产生的单一框架之内。该框架基于一个双尺度系统，该系统由两个满足几乎爱因斯坦方程和某些正则性条件的权重为一的共形标量组成。作为这一统一框架的一个具体实例，我们为 Spi 和 Ti（Ricci 平坦时空的扩展空间无穷远与时间无穷远）获得了一种新的环境构造。该构造的一个显著特征是：Spi/Ti 与相应时空的零无穷远分别被自然地实现为双尺度环境空间的一个边界面和该边界面的角。我们还展示了双尺度系统如何能够作为背景环境几何，用于研究（规范）场在空间无穷远、时间无穷远和零无穷远处的渐近行为。
